definitions.explanation: A circular object that rotates around an axle, used for transportation in vehicles.

examples.japanese: {車輪|しゃりん}が{回|まわ}っている。
{自転車|じてんしゃ}の{車輪|しゃりん}がパンクした。
examples.english: My bicycle wheel got a flat tire.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{車輪|しゃりん}が{線路|せんろ}の{上|うえ}を{走|はし}る。
examples.english: The train's wheels run on the tracks.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{車輪|しゃりん}が{回|まわ}る (the wheel turns)
・{前輪|ぜんりん} (front wheel)
・{後輪|こうりん} (rear wheel)
・{両輪|りょうりん} (both wheels; figuratively, two essential parts)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・タイヤ - tire (the rubber part)
・ホイール - wheel (loanword, often for car alloy wheels)
・{輪|わ} - ring, circle, wheel (general)

IDIOM:
・{両輪|りょうりん}のように - like two wheels (= two essential complementary parts)

[Register: Neutral]
